Płyniesz swoim jachtem (rejon: {area}; d: You are out on your own yacht (area: {area}; vessel details are on the variant card alongside). A fire has broken out in the engine compartment, the extinguisher is not enough and the smoke is getting thicker. The crew's lives are in immediate danger - this is a DISTRESS situation.
Gdy ACK nie przyjdzie w ok. 15 sekund, w: If no ACK arrives within about 15 seconds, press 16/C and send MAYDAY by voice on 16. Do not switch off the alert and do not wait indefinitely: the radio keeps repeating the DSC alert every 3.5-4.5 minutes.
Włącz radiostację (przytrzymaj pokrętło: Switch the radio on (hold the [DIAL] knob for 1 s)
Włącz radio i wybierz kanał 16 do nasłuc: Switch the radio on and select channel 16 for the voice listening watch. A separate DSC receiver watches channel 70; just switching the radio on while it is on another channel does not give you a voice watch on 16. Without power there is no watch and no way to send an alert.
M330: [DISTRESS] lub Menu > Distress. M3: M330: [DISTRESS] or Menu > Distress. M323: Menu > DSC Calls > Distress Call
Alarm \"designated\" (z podanym rodzajem: A "designated" alert (with the nature of distress set) tells the rescuers WHAT is happening before they hear your voice. The Distress screen lets you choose the nature before sending.
Ustaw Nature: Fire,Explosion ([ENT] na w: Set Nature: Fire,Explosion ([ENT] on the Nature line, choose, [ENT])
Rodzaj zagrożenia idzie w cyfrowym alerc: The nature of distress travels in the digital alert (ITU-R M.493). SAR services know straight away what equipment and procedures to prepare. If you do not choose, "Undesignated" goes out - it works, but says less.
Podnieś osłonę i PRZYTRZYMAJ czerwony [D: Lift the cover and HOLD the red [DISTRESS] key for 3 seconds
Osłona i wymóg 3 sekund chronią przed pr: The cover and the 3-second hold protect against accidental alerts (false alerts are a real problem for GMDSS). The radio counts down with beeps and sends the DSC alert on channel 70: MMSI + GPS position + nature of distress.
Po ACK: ALARM OFF, potem MAYDAY na 16. B: After ACK: ALARM OFF, then MAYDAY on 16. No ACK after about 15 s: 16/C and MAYDAY (PTT)
Po ACK wybierz ALARM OFF. Jeżeli ACK nie: After the ACK, select ALARM OFF. If no ACK arrives after about 15 seconds, select 16/C and send MAYDAY without waiting any longer; the digital alert keeps repeating. The digital alert is only a header; by voice you give what DSC does not carry: the number of people on board, how the situation is developing and the help you need. Order (MIPDANIO): MAYDAY x3 -> THIS IS + name x3 -> call sign/MMSI -> MAYDAY + name -> position -> nature of distress -> assistance required -> number of people -> OVER.
PTT przed nadaniem alertu DSC - najpierw: PTT before sending the DSC alert - alert first (channel 70), then voice.
Alert poszedł bez rodzaju zagrożenia (Un: The alert went out without the nature of distress (Undesignated) - it works, but the rescuers know less.
Członek załogi wypadł za burtę i pozosta: A crew member has fallen overboard and is still in the water. You can see them, but you cannot safely get them back on board and you need immediate help. Send a DSC Man Overboard alert and MAYDAY on channel 16.
Widoczność osoby i kamizelka nie usuwają: Being able to see the person and their lifejacket does not remove the danger to life. Practise MAYDAY for UKE task 10 as well. Once the person is recovered, tell the rescue station the situation has changed. Do not cancel a real incident that has ended as if it were a false alert.
Ustaw Nature: Man Overboard ([ENT] na wi: Set Nature: Man Overboard ([ENT] on the Nature line, choose, [ENT])
Silnik zgasł i nie odpala, kotwica nie t: The engine has died and will not restart, the anchor is not holding and the yacht is drifting towards the shore. Nobody is in the water, but you need a tow before it gets dangerous. This is classic URGENCY: PAN-PAN.
M330: [OTHER DSC]. M323: Menu > DSC Call: M330: [OTHER DSC]. M323: Menu > DSC Calls > All Ships Call
Awaria bez zagrożenia życia = pilność, n: A breakdown with no danger to life is urgency, not distress. You build the call from the DSC menu, not with the red key.
Zapowiedź DSC dociera też do stacji brze: The DSC announcement also reaches the coast station - often the quickest way to arrange a tow.
W treści podaj: pozycję, co się stało (a: In the message give: your position, what happened (breakdown, drifting), what you need (a tow), how many people on board. End with OVER - you are waiting for a reply.
DISTRESS przy zwykłej awarii = fałszywy: DISTRESS for an ordinary breakdown = a false alert. Life is not in immediate danger.
Mijasz na wpół zatopiony kontener dryfuj: You pass a half-sunken container drifting near the fairway. You are not in danger, but it is a real navigational hazard for others. Category SAFETY: SECURITE.
M330: [OTHER DSC]. M323: DSC Calls > All: M330: [OTHER DSC]. M323: DSC Calls > All Ships. Set Safety -> Send
Zapowiedź Safety na kanale 70 uprzedza w: A Safety announcement on channel 70 warns everyone that a safety message is about to follow on 16. As with urgency, there is no DSC acknowledgement.
Na kanale 16 zapowiedz SECURITE i wskaż: On channel 16, announce SECURITE and name working channel 72
Format egzaminacyjny UKE: na 16 idzie kr: UKE exam format: on 16 you give a short SECURITE announcement saying where to listen for the message. Channel 16 stays free for calling and distress.
Pełna treść ostrzeżenia jest dłuższa niż: The full warning is longer than the announcement. Moving it elsewhere keeps channel 16 from being blocked.
Nadaj pełną treść SECURITE na 72 i zakoń: Send the full SECURITE message on 72 and end with OUT
Powtórz SECURITE, ALL STATIONS i identyf: Repeat SECURITE, ALL STATIONS and your identification, then say what, where and what action you recommend. OUT means you expect no reply.
Kategoria Urgency zamiast Safety - ostrz: Urgency category instead of Safety - a navigational warning belongs to the safety category.
Wychodzisz z portu ({marina}) i chcesz s: You are leaving harbour ({marina}) and want to check that the radio transmits and receives. For this radio check use the marina's working channel: {marinaCh}. Channel 16 can also be used for a brief call, but not for routine conversation or testing the radio.
Kanał 16 jest zarezerwowany dla niebezpi: Channel 16 is reserved for distress and calling - you must not block it with tests. {marinaNote}
Do bliskiej łączności użyj najmniejszej: For short-range communication use the lowest power that works, here 1 W. You reduce interference and battery drain. Switch to 25 W if the signal is too weak or it is an emergency.
Schemat: [stacja wywoływana] x2 -> THIS: Pattern: [station called] x2 -> THIS IS + name x2 -> RADIO CHECK -> OVER. The reply rates readability on a scale of 1-5 ("READABILITY FIVE" = perfect) or says "LOUD AND CLEAR".
Radio check na kanale 16 - kanał alarmow: Radio check on channel 16 - the distress channel is not for tests. Use the marina's working channel.
Podczas sprzątania kokpitu ktoś oparł si: While someone was tidying the cockpit, they leaned on the radio and a DISTRESS alert went out (nature: Undesignated). Nothing is wrong, everyone is fine. A false alert must be cancelled IMMEDIATELY - digitally and by voice - or a rescue operation will be launched.
Ten scenariusz zaczyna się JUŻ PO fałszy: This scenario starts AFTER the false alert has gone out (the radio is waiting for ACK). In real life: do not panic and do not switch the radio off "to make it quiet" - cancel digitally and by voice.
Samo wyłączenie radia NIE zatrzymuje pro: Just switching the radio off does NOT stop the procedure - the alert has already gone and the radio may keep repeating it once switched back on. A radio with a cancel function sends a digital cancellation (ITU-R M.493).
Potwierdź [CONTINUE] - poleci DSC cancel: Confirm with [CONTINUE] - the DSC cancel goes out and the radio selects channel 16
Cyfrowe odwołanie zatrzymuje automatyczn: The digital cancellation stops the automatic alert repeats for every receiving station. But the IMO procedure also requires a cancellation BY VOICE.
Nadaj odwołanie głosem na 16 (PTT): \"AL: Send the cancellation by voice on 16 (PTT): "ALL STATIONS... CANCEL MY DISTRESS ALERT..."
Formuła IMO: ALL STATIONS x3 -> THIS IS: IMO formula: ALL STATIONS x3 -> THIS IS + name x3, call sign, MMSI, position -> CANCEL MY DISTRESS ALERT OF [date, time UTC]. Then keep watch on 16 and answer the coast station's questions. There is no penalty for a false alert cancelled promptly.
Na M330 FINISH zamyka część głosową, a S: On the M330, FINISH closes the voice part and STBY ends the whole procedure. On the M323, FINISH goes straight back to normal operation. Stay on watch on 16.
Wywołanie mariny - miejsce w porcie: Calling the marina - a berth for the night
Podchodzisz do portu ({marina}) i chcesz: You are approaching harbour ({marina}) and want to book a berth for the night. This is routine traffic - on the marina's working channel ({marinaCh}), not on 16.
Sprawy portowe załatwia się na kanale ro: Harbour matters are dealt with on the marina's working channel. {marinaNote} Channel 16 stays free for calling and distress.
Wywołaj marinę i poproś o miejsce (PTT): Call the marina and ask for a berth (PTT)
Schemat: [stacja] x2 -> THIS IS + nazwa: Pattern: [station] x2 -> THIS IS + name x2 -> message (request) -> OVER. Keep it short and to the point: what you need, what vessel, how many people.
Wywołanie portowe na kanale 16 - użyj ka: Harbour call on channel 16 - use the marina's working channel ({marinaCh}).
Wchodzisz w rejon ruchu ({area}). Służba: You are entering a traffic area ({area}). {vts} (channel {vtsCh}) manages the traffic - report in with your position and intentions. This is routine traffic.
{vts} pracuje na kanale {vtsCh}. Melduje: {vts} works on channel {vtsCh}. You report in there, not on 16 - 16 stays free for calling and distress.
Zgłoś się do VTS z pozycją i zamiarem (P: Report to VTS with your position and intentions (PTT)
Podaj: kogo wołasz, twoja nazwa i znak,: Give: who you are calling, your name and call sign, position, intentions (entering/leaving, where to). VTS needs your position and intentions to separate the traffic.
Członek załogi mocno rozciął dłoń, krwaw: A crew member has cut their hand badly and the bleeding is hard to stop. Life is not yet in immediate danger, but you need medical advice. This is medical URGENCY: PAN-PAN.
Sprawy medyczne to Urgency, dopóki życie: Medical cases are Urgency as long as life is not in immediate danger. Heart attack, loss of consciousness, massive bleeding - that is already MAYDAY. Medical advice comes from the coast station (RADIO MEDICO / the SAR service).
Zapowiedź pilności składa się jako All S: The urgency announcement is built as All Ships - as for any PAN-PAN. The red DISTRESS key is only for immediate danger to life.
Kategoria Urgency obejmuje także sprawy: The Urgency category also covers medical cases. The announcement on 70 sends everyone to 16 - a doctor can reply through the coast station (RADIO MEDICO).
Nadaj PAN-PAN medyczny głosem na 16: Send a medical PAN-PAN by voice on 16
Struktura jak PAN-PAN: PAN PAN x3 -> ALL: Same structure as PAN-PAN: PAN PAN x3 -> ALL STATIONS x3 -> THIS IS + name -> position -> injury -> REQUEST MEDICAL ADVICE -> number of people -> OVER.
Czerwony DISTRESS przy kontuzji bez zagr: Red DISTRESS for an injury with no danger to life = a false alert. If life were in danger (heart attack, loss of consciousness) - then MAYDAY.
Test DSC do stacji brzegowej: DSC test call to a coast station
Chcesz sprawdzić, czy cały łańcuch DSC d: You want to check that the whole DSC chain works (MMSI, GPS, transmitting on 70). That is what a Test call to a coast station is for - without alerting anyone by voice.
Wybierz Test Call do stacji brzegowej (M: Choose Test Call to the coast station (M330: [OTHER DSC] > Type: Test; M323: DSC Calls > Test Call)
Test to specjalny typ DSC - stacja brzeg: Test is a special DSC call type - the coast station replies with an automatic ACK. Address it to the coast station ({coast}), not to All Ships.
Radio nadaje krótką ramkę testową na kan: The radio sends a short test frame on channel 70. No voice goes out - it is a purely digital check.
Czekaj na cyfrowe potwierdzenie (ACK) wy: Wait for the digital acknowledgement (ACK) from the station called
Wywołania Individual i Test potwierdza c: Individual and Test calls are acknowledged digitally by the station called. After the ACK the radio shows the agreed working channel - channels 16 and 70 stay free.
ACK potwierdza, że twój MMSI i tor nadaw: The ACK confirms that your MMSI and your transmit and receive path work. It is the best way to check DSC without a false alert - there is no voice part.
Test wysłany jako All Ships - test kieru: Test sent as All Ships - a test goes to a specific coast station, which replies with ACK.
Chcesz porozmawiać z jednostką szkolną (: You want to talk to the training vessel (TRAINING SHIP). The modern way is an Individual DSC call: the radio "rings" a specific MMSI and proposes a working channel, and the conversation is by voice - you do not tie up 16.
Wybierz Individual Call (M330: [OTHER DS: Choose Individual Call (M330: [OTHER DSC] > Type: Individual; M323: DSC Calls > Individual Call)
Individual to wywołanie do jednego, konk: Individual is a call to one specific MMSI - like a phone call. Group and All Ships are other call types.
Ustaw adresata (TRAINING SHIP) i kanał r: Set the addressee (TRAINING SHIP) and a working channel (e.g. 72), then Send
W wywołaniu Individual wskazujesz MMSI o: In an Individual call you enter the recipient's MMSI and the proposed working channel. Never propose 16 for a conversation - it is the calling and distress channel.
Wyłącz sygnał ([ALARM OFF]) - radio prze: Silence the alarm ([ALARM OFF]) - the radio will switch to the working channel
Po ACK obie stacje są na uzgodnionym kan: After the ACK both stations are on the agreed working channel and the voice conversation can begin.
Rozmawiaj na uzgodnionym kanale roboczym: Talk on the agreed working channel (PTT)
Po ACK obie stacje są na kanale roboczym: After the ACK both stations are on the working channel. Voice call: [vessel] x2 -> THIS IS + name x2 -> message -> OVER.
Wywołanie rutynowe wskazało kanał 16 do: The routine call proposed channel 16 for the conversation - choose a working channel (e.g. 72).
Przed startem chcesz przekazać komunikat: Before the start you want to pass a message to your whole racing group at once. That is what a DSC group call (Group) is for - it reaches the vessels with the same group number, and you give the message by voice on a working channel.
Wybierz Group Call (M330: [OTHER DSC] >: Choose Group Call (M330: [OTHER DSC] > Type: Group; M323: DSC Calls > Group Call)
Group to wywołanie do zaprogramowanej gr: Group is a call to a programmed group of vessels (a shared group MMSI). It is not acknowledged with ACK - like All Ships.
Ustaw kanał roboczy i wyślij wywołanie g: Set the working channel and send the group call (Send)
Zapowiedź grupowa na kanale 70 kieruje c: The group announcement on channel 70 sends the whole group to the chosen working channel. The group does not reply digitally - you go straight to voice.
Nadaj komunikat do floty głosem (PTT): Send the message to the fleet by voice (PTT)
Schemat: [nazwa grupy] x2 -> THIS IS + n: Pattern: [group name] x2 -> THIS IS + name x2 -> message -> OVER.
Słyszysz na 16 słaby MAYDAY jachtu NEPTU: On 16 you hear a weak MAYDAY from the yacht NEPTUN (sinking, 3 people on board), but the coast station does not answer - your signal reaches further. Your duty is to relay this alert: MAYDAY RELAY. You do NOT send your own MAYDAY (you are not in danger) and you do not use the red key.
MAYDAY RELAY nadaje stacja, która ODEBRA: MAYDAY RELAY is sent by a station that HAS RECEIVED someone else's MAYDAY and sees that nobody is acknowledging it - typically a coast station, but also a ship with better range. Do not confuse it with your own MAYDAY.
Upewnij się, że jesteś na kanale 16 (kró: Make sure you are on channel 16 (short press [16/C])
Retransmisja MAYDAY idzie głosem na 16 -: A MAYDAY relay goes by voice on 16 - that is where distress traffic is heard. A short press of [16/C] always returns to 16.
Nadaj MAYDAY RELAY głosem na 16: Send MAYDAY RELAY by voice on 16
Formuła: MAYDAY RELAY x3 -> ALL STATIONS: Formula: MAYDAY RELAY x3 -> ALL STATIONS x3 -> THIS IS + YOUR name x3 -> "RECEIVED FOLLOWING MAYDAY FROM..." -> name, position, nature of distress and number of people of the vessel in distress -> OVER. You relay SOMEONE ELSE'S details, not your own.
Czerwony DISTRESS przy retransmisji = na: Red DISTRESS while relaying = sending YOUR OWN alert. You are not in danger - MAYDAY RELAY goes by voice only.
Radio odebrało DSC DISTRESS z jachtu NEP: The radio has received a DSC DISTRESS from the yacht NEPTUN. Silence the alarm, go to 16 and listen for 5 minutes. Check whether the coast or an RCC has acknowledged the alert and is handling the traffic. If there is no response, acknowledge by voice and inform the coast or the RCC. A DSC ACK from a ship is not the first step.
Procedura IMO MSC.1/Circ.1657: 1) słucha: IMO procedure MSC.1/Circ.1657: 1) listen on 16 for 5 minutes; 2) check for an ACK and traffic from the coast or an RCC; 3) if there is none, acknowledge by voice, inform the coast or the RCC and assess how you can help. Exception: if further alerts keep coming in, the ship is beyond doubt close by and you have consulted an RCC or the coast station, a DSC ACK may stop the repeats.
Wycisz alarm ([ALARM OFF]) - radio ustaw: Silence the alarm ([ALARM OFF]) - the radio will select channel 16 for listening
Przedwczesny DSC ACK ze statku może zatr: A premature DSC ACK from a ship can stop the repeats before an RCC takes over the alert. The current IMO procedure requires 5 minutes of listening on 16 and assessing the coast's response.
Brak odpowiedzi stacji brzegowej - potwi: No response from the coast station - acknowledge receipt BY VOICE on 16
Gdy nikt nie potwierdza, a jesteś w zasi: If nobody acknowledges and you are within range: MAYDAY + name of the vessel in distress x3 -> THIS IS + YOUR name x3 -> RECEIVED MAYDAY. Then consider relaying and assisting.
Nadałeś WŁASNY alarm DISTRESS - tobie ni: You sent YOUR OWN DISTRESS alert - you are not in danger. Someone else's MAYDAY is acknowledged or relayed, not duplicated with your own alert.
Radio \"dzwoni\": jednostka szkolna (TRA: The radio is "ringing": the training vessel (TRAINING SHIP) is calling you individually by DSC and proposing working channel 72. Accept the call and reply by voice on the agreed channel.
Przyjmij wywołanie ([ACCEPT]) - radio pr: Accept the call ([ACCEPT]) - the radio will switch to the proposed channel 72
ACCEPT potwierdza przyjęcie i automatycz: ACCEPT confirms the call and automatically switches to the working channel proposed by the caller - no need to look for the channel by hand.
Odpowiedz głosem na kanale roboczym (PTT: Reply by voice on the working channel (PTT)
Odpowiadasz na kanale roboczym: [wywołuj: You reply on the working channel: [caller] x2 -> THIS IS + name x2 -> message (GO AHEAD / your reply) -> OVER.
Pamięć skanowania: sprawdź i dodaj kanał: Scan memory: check and add channels
Wykonaj zadania 6 i 7 UKE. Najpierw rozp: Do UKE tasks 6 and 7. First identify the channel already marked with the FAV star, then add 06, 13 and 16 to the scan list.
Przewijaj kanały i znajdź oznaczony kana: Scroll through the channels and find the marked channel 12
Gwiazdka na ekranie oznacza kanał należą: A star on the screen means the channel is on the scan list. Just switching SCAN on does not show the full list.
Ustaw kanał 06, pokaż [FAV] i naciśnij g: Select channel 06, bring up [FAV] and press it
FAV działa jak przełącznik: pierwsze nac: FAV works as a toggle: the first press adds the star, the second removes the channel from the list.
Ustaw kanał 13 i dodaj go [FAV]: Select channel 13 and add it with [FAV]
Lista jest pamięcią kanałów, które SCAN: The list is a memory of the channels that SCAN will check in turn once the squelch is closed.
Ustaw kanał 16 i dodaj go [FAV]: Select channel 16 and add it with [FAV]
Po zadaniu lista ma zawierać 06, 13 i 16: After the task the list must contain 06, 13 and 16. Before starting SCAN, set SQL above OPEN.
Odbiornik GPS jest odłączony. Wprowadź r: The GPS receiver is disconnected. Enter latitude, longitude and UTC time manually, following the path required in UKE task 14. Manual data is valid only for 23.5 hours or until the radio is switched off.
Pozycja do DSC jest ustawieniem systemu: The DSC position is a setting of the DSC system, not a channel setting or a time zone offset.
Ręczny wpis jest dostępny tylko bez praw: Manual entry is available only when there is no valid GPS data. With GPS active the radio locks this screen so the position cannot be overwritten by accident.
Sprawdź szerokość geograficzną i zatwier: Check the latitude and confirm with [FIN]
Najpierw szerokość: stopnie, minuty dzie: Latitude first: degrees, decimal minutes and N or S. The wrong hemisphere puts your position on the other side of the world.
Sprawdź długość geograficzną i zatwierdź: Check the longitude and confirm with [FIN]
Długość ma trzy cyfry stopni i znak E al: Longitude has three digits of degrees and E or W. Keep the leading zeros, e.g. 018 degrees.
Sprawdź czas UTC i zapisz [FIN]: Check the UTC time and save with [FIN]
DSC wysyła pozycję razem z czasem jej us: DSC sends the position together with the time it was fixed. An old position without a time can send the rescuers to the wrong place.
Wykonaj zadanie 15 UKE: zapisz duńską st: Do UKE task 15: save the Danish coast station LYNGBY under its correct MMSI 002191000.
Wejdź: MENU > DSC Settings > Individual: Go to: MENU > DSC Settings > Individual ID
Rejestr Individual ID jest książką adres: The Individual ID register is the DSC address book. You are not sending a call yet.
Numer stacji brzegowej ma dziewięć cyfr: A coast station number has nine digits and starts with 00. The radio locks these two digits.
MMSI musi być dokładny. Jedna zła cyfra: The MMSI must be exact. One wrong digit means a different addressee or no reply at all.
Nazwa LYNGBY jest gotowa. Naciśnij [FIN]: The name LYNGBY is ready. Press [FIN]
Nazwa jest etykietą dla operatora, ale w: The name is a label for the operator, but the call is addressed by the nine-digit MMSI.
Wykonaj zadanie 16 UKE: znajdź LYNGBY, u: Do UKE task 16: find LYNGBY, use DEL and confirm with OK. CANCEL must leave the entry unchanged.
Usuwasz wpis z książki adresowej, nie z: You are deleting an entry from the address book, not from the DSC call log.
Najpierw sprawdź nazwę i pełny MMSI 0021: First check the name and the full MMSI 002191000. DEL opens a confirmation, it does not delete anything yet.
OK usuwa wpis trwale. CANCEL wraca do li: OK deletes the entry permanently. CANCEL goes back to the list without changes.
Jedno pokrętło pełni trzy role: zasilani: One knob does three jobs: power, volume and squelch (the noise gate). Holding it for about 1 second switches the radio on or off, a short press toggles between VOL and SQL, and turning it adjusts whichever value is selected.
ICOM oszczędza miejsce na wodoszczelnym: ICOM saves space on the waterproof panel: one knob instead of three. Squelch is not "quieter" - it sets the threshold below which the receiver does not open the speaker at all, so squelch set too high cuts out weak, distant calls, including a distress call.
Zaraz po włączeniu: podnieś głośność, po: Straight after switching on: turn the volume up, then lower the squelch until you hear noise and raise it exactly to the point where the noise DISAPPEARS - that is the most sensitive threshold. On the IC-M323 further presses go on: VOL, SQL, channel selection (CH) and backlight, while on the IC-M330GE the cycle ends at SQL.
Cały stan radia naraz: górny pasek statu: The whole state of the radio at once: the status bar at the top (channel group, GPS, watch mode, power, supply), the large channel number in the middle, menu content, the labels above the softkeys and the TX/RX line at the bottom.
Radio nie potwierdza niczego głosem. Jed: The radio confirms nothing by voice. The only proof that you are on the right channel, at the right power, and that the alert really went out is what you see on the screen.
Patrzysz na niego przed każdym nadaniem: You look at it before every transmission and after every DSC action. In the exam, the examiner grades what is on the screen, not what you meant to do.
Duża cyfra na środku wyświetlacza: kanał: The large digits in the middle of the display: the channel the radio is listening on now and the one you will transmit on when you press PTT. A channel description appears next to it, e.g. 16 = DISTRESS/CALLING, 12 = port operations, 70 = DSC.
Kanał decyduje o tym, czy ktokolwiek cię: The channel decides whether anyone hears you at all - a flawless procedure on the wrong channel is useless. That is why the number is the largest thing on the screen: it is the first thing you check before transmitting.
Zawsze przed naciśnięciem PTT i po każdy: Always before pressing PTT and after every DSC call - after accepting a call the radio jumps to the agreed working channel by itself, and you need to see that.
Krótkie naciśnięcie natychmiast wraca na: A short press returns to channel 16 at once - from almost any screen, including the menu and the volume or squelch adjustment. Holding it for about 1 second switches to the Call Channel: a programmable user shortcut, set to channel 16 at the factory; in our simulator it holds channel 06.
Kanał 16 to kanał nasłuchu, wywołań i ni: Channel 16 is the watch, calling and distress channel - it has to be reachable in one move, blind, without leaving the menu. That is why the manufacturer gives it its own dedicated key instead of a place in a list.
Gdy tylko musisz wrócić do nasłuchu albo: Whenever you need to get back to the listening watch or start a voice call. Always after a DSC alert: distress traffic goes by voice on 16.
Otwiera i zamyka menu radia. IC-M330GE m: Opens and closes the radio menu. The IC-M330GE has the items Distress, Other DSC, GPS, Configuration, DSC Log, Radio Settings, DSC Settings, Radio Info; the IC-M323 has a shorter list: DSC Calls, DSC Settings, Radio Settings, Configuration, MMSI/GPS Info.
Wszystko, co nie ma własnego klawisza -: Everything that has no key of its own - digital calls, the DSC log, settings, MMSI and position info - lives in the menu. Different models have different menu trees, so in the exam it pays to know which set is in front of you.
Gdy budujesz wywołanie DSC bez skrótu so: When you build a DSC call without a softkey shortcut (on the IC-M323 it is the only way), when you check the MMSI and position or look through the log of received calls. MENU works from standby, and you leave the menu with the same key.
Zatwierdza to, co jest podświetlone: poz: Confirms whatever is highlighted: a menu item, the nature of distress from the Nature list, a DSC call field (type, addressee, category, working channel) and, at the end, sending the assembled Other DSC call. ENT does not send a DISTRESS alert - that goes out only after a 3-second hold of the red key.
Wywołanie DSC składasz z pól. ENT jest j: You build a DSC call from fields. ENT is the only confirmation of each step - so scrolling through a list changes nothing until you deliberately confirm.
Po każdym wyborze na liście oraz na końc: After every choice in a list and at the end, on the send item - then ENT transmits the Other DSC call on channel 70. Exception: a DISTRESS alert does not go through ENT, only after a 3-second hold of the red key under the cover.
Cofa o jeden krok: zamyka regulację głoś: Goes back one step: closes the volume, squelch, channel selection and backlight adjustment, leaves an info view for the menu, the menu for standby, the Nature list for the Distress screen. On the IC-M330GE the key is labelled CLR, on the IC-M323 - CLEAR.
Bez klawisza wyjścia każda pomyłka w men: Without an exit key, every slip in the menu would leave you stuck on the wrong screen just when time matters. CLR/CLEAR is your back button.
Zawsze, gdy wszedłeś nie tam, gdzie chci: Whenever you have ended up somewhere you did not mean to go. Note: CLR does NOT cancel a DISTRESS alert that has already gone out - a false alert is cancelled with the DSC CANCEL procedure plus a voice cancellation on channel 16.
In standby it raises the channel number by one. In the menu and in lists (Nature, DSC fields, the log) it moves the cursor up.
Stały panel VHF nie ma klawiatury numery: A fixed VHF panel has no numeric keypad - you cannot type in channel 72, you step to it. Two arrow keys handle both the channels and all the list navigation, so the panel stays small and watertight.
Przy przejściu na uzgodniony kanał roboc: When moving to the agreed working channel after a call on 16, and when moving through the menu or the list of distress natures.
Odwrotność strzałki w górę: w czuwaniu o: The opposite of the up arrow: in standby it lowers the channel number, in the menu and in lists it moves the cursor down.
Zmiana kanału w dwie strony musi być moż: Changing channel in both directions has to be possible with one hand, without looking at the keys - the other hand is on the helm or the microphone.
Gdy schodzisz na niższy kanał (np. z 16: When you step down to a lower channel (e.g. from 16 to 12 to call the port) and when you choose a menu item or a nature of distress in the Nature list.
Na tym panelu, jak w IC-M330GE, strzałki: On this panel, as on the IC-M330GE, the side arrows do not change channel: they scroll through the pages of function keys. Left goes back to the previous page of labels above the softkeys.
Cztery softkeye nie pomieszczą wszystkic: Four softkeys cannot hold every function at once, so they are spread over several pages. The arrows are the only way to reach a page you cannot currently see.
Gdy potrzebna funkcja (SCAN, DW, BKLT, L: When the function you need (SCAN, DW, BKLT, LOG, FAV) is not shown at the bottom of the screen. Works in standby.
Lustrzane odbicie strzałki w lewo: przec: The mirror image of the left arrow: it moves to the next page of function keys. The pages loop, so pressing on brings you back to the start.
Strony softkeyów są zapętlone i zawsze i: The softkey pages loop and always come in the same order, so after a few tries you reach a function from muscle memory rather than searching for it by eye. On top of that, the softkey set changes with the state of the radio: you see one thing in standby and another on the screen of a received DSC call. So know first what you are looking for, and only then scroll.
Kiedy szukasz funkcji, której nie widać: When you are looking for a function not shown on the current page - scroll right. Works in standby.
Cztery klawisze bezpośrednio pod ekranem: Four keys directly below the screen. They have no fixed meaning - they do exactly what the bottom line of the LCD says above them at that moment.
Kontekstowe klawisze pozwalają małemu pa: Context keys let a small panel handle dozens of functions and, in an emergency, show only the actions that make sense right now: CANCEL, RESEND, PAUSE, INFO, ALARM OFF, ACCEPT, REFUSE.
Za każdym razem, gdy ekran się zmienia:: Every time the screen changes: after receiving a DSC call, after sending an alert, after entering the menu, after scrolling a page. There is one rule: first read the label on the screen, then press the key below it. Pressing from memory when the key already shows something else is the most common way to send something you did not mean to.
Funkcje softkeyów są rozłożone na kilku: The softkey functions are spread over several pages, scrolled with the side arrows. IC-M330GE standby: page 1 is DISTRESS, OTHER DSC, HI/LO, CHAN; page 2 is SCAN, DW, AQUA, BKLT; page 3 is LOG, NAME, FAV.
Funkcji jest więcej niż klawiszy, więc s: There are more functions than keys, so the set trades panel space for one extra press. The IC-M323 has a different layout and has neither DISTRESS nor OTHER DSC on its softkeys - there DSC is done through MENU.
Za każdym razem, gdy szukana funkcja nie: Whenever the function you want is not shown - scroll with the arrows. If no MMSI is programmed, the DISTRESS and OTHER DSC softkeys are blank: without an identity the radio will not let you send any DSC call.
Przełącza moc nadawania między 25 W (HI): Switches transmit power between 25 W (HI) and 1 W (LO). The result shows straight away in the status bar at the top.
Moc to zasięg, ale także zasięg zakłócan: Power means range, but also range of interference: 25 W in a marina ties up the channel for everyone as far as the radio horizon - a dozen or so miles between yachts and 20-30 miles to a coast station's high antenna. On low-power channels (15, 17, and also 75 and 76) the radio forces 1 W whatever your setting.
LO w porcie, w marinie i przy rozmowie z: LO in harbour, in the marina and when talking to the boat next to you. HI to a coast station, in open water and always for a distress call - the wrong power is one of the most common mistakes in the exam.
Włącza podwójny nasłuch: radio na przemi: Switches on dual watch: the radio alternately checks your working channel and channel 16. The DW indicator appears in the top bar; switching DW on turns SCAN off and vice versa.
Nasłuch na kanale 16 jest obowiązkiem op: Keeping watch on channel 16 is the operator's duty, but you have to work on a working channel. Dual Watch lets you do both at once without giving up the watch.
Włączasz, gdy przechodzisz z 16 na kanał: Switch it on when you move from 16 to a working channel (e.g. 72) and still want to hear calls on 16 - and leave it on, because the watch on 16 is the operator's duty. If in an exceptional situation you turn it off (e.g. a long, precise exchange with VTS), switch it back on as soon as you are done.
Uruchamia przeszukiwanie kanałów z listy: Starts scanning the channels on the favourites list - here 06, 12 and 16 by default - which you set with the FAV softkey. You choose the scan type in Radio Settings: Normal scans only the favourites, Priority scans the favourites and keeps checking channel 16 between them. With fewer than two favourites the scan will not start.
Skan pozwala pilnować kilku kanałów nara: Scanning lets you keep an eye on several channels at once - port, marina and 16 - instead of picking one and missing the rest. That is handy on an approach where traffic runs on several channels at the same time.
Na podejściu do portu, gdy interesuje ci: On the approach to a harbour, when you care about VTS, the port and 16 alike. Turn it off before you start transmitting: scanning and working on one channel exclude each other, and SCAN turns DW off.
Na IC-M330GE (strona 1 softkeyów) otwier: On the IC-M330GE (softkey page 1) it opens the alert-building screen, where you choose the nature of distress from the Nature list: Fire, Flooding, Collision, Grounding, Sinking, Man Overboard and the rest. The IC-M323 has no such shortcut - the same path goes through MENU, DSC Calls, Distress.
Alarm z określonym rodzajem zagrożenia m: An alert with the nature of distress set tells the rescuers what to expect before you have even said a word. An Undesignated alert works too, but carries less information - choosing the nature costs a few seconds and greatly improves the alert.
Gdy masz kilkanaście sekund i wiesz, co: When you have a dozen or so seconds and know what is happening - choose the nature of distress before you hold the red key. Note: this screen sends nothing; the alert goes out only after a 3-second hold of the DISTRESS key under the cover.
Trzymasz - nadajesz (TX), puszczasz - sł: Hold it - you transmit (TX), release it - you listen (RX). On channel 70 PTT will not send voice: it is a digital-only channel (DSC).
Radio jest simpleksowe: w danej chwili a: The radio is simplex: at any moment you either transmit or listen, never both at once. While you hold PTT you are deaf - you will not hear someone breaking in or a distress call going out on 16. Never transmit without an antenna connected: the reflected power can burn out the transmitter's final stage.
Wciśnij, zrób pół sekundy pauzy, dopiero: Press, pause for half a second, and only then speak - otherwise the first word gets cut off. Keep it brief, hand over with OVER and let go: holding it down for long blocks the channel for everyone around.
Sprężynowa klapka nad czerwonym klawisze: A spring-loaded flap over the red key, usually with red and black stripes. On its own it sends nothing - you have to lift it to reach the button at all.
Fałszywe alarmy DSC to realny problem GM: False DSC alerts are a real problem for GMDSS: each one sets the services in motion and occupies channel 70. The cover is a physical barrier against catching the button with a hand, a sheet, a jacket or a backpack.
Podnosisz ją wyłącznie wtedy, gdy napraw: Lift it only when you really do have to send an alert. When checking the equipment, make sure it is not broken off and the button under it is not jammed.
Przytrzymanie 3 sekund (radio odlicza na: Holding it for 3 seconds (the radio counts down on the screen and beeps) sends a digital DSC alert on channel 70: your MMSI, your GPS position with its time and the nature of distress you selected.
Jedno przytrzymanie robi to, co głosem z: One hold does what by voice would take a minute and a calm you do not have at that moment. The alert reaches every DSC station in range at once and gives them your identity and position straight away - that is why it is faster and more reliable than a voice MAYDAY.
TYLKO przy bezpośrednim, poważnym zagroż: ONLY when life or the vessel is in immediate, grave danger. Once it is sent, the radio repeats the alert by itself at random intervals of 3.5 to 4.5 minutes until an acknowledgement (ACK) arrives, while you switch to channel 16 and send MAYDAY by voice. A false alert is cancelled at once: CANCEL in DSC plus a voice cancellation on 16 to all stations (name, call sign, MMSI, time the alert was sent).
Pokazuje aktywną grupę kanałów. Europejs: Shows the active channel group. The European IC-M330GE and IC-M323 work only in the international INT group - the USA and CAN groups exist only on the American versions of these radios. Our panel, like every radio used in Europe, is set to INT.
Te same numery kanałów mają w różnych gr: The same channel numbers have different frequencies and a different mode of operation in different groups. The wrong group means you are transmitting off to the side of everyone else even though the right number is on the screen - and nobody notices until someone tries to call you.
Sprawdzasz przy pierwszym uruchomieniu r: Check it when you first power up the radio on a new boat and after someone has been poking around in the settings. In Europe the screen should show INT.
Zapala się, gdy odbiornik jest otwarty:: Lights up when the receiver is open: either you are receiving something or the squelch is set to OPEN. It is exactly the same condition in which you hear the speaker - never one without the other.
To jedyny sposób, żeby zobaczyć, że kana: It is the only way to see that the channel is busy before you press PTT and talk over someone. With SQL set correctly it lights up only when someone is actually transmitting.
Glance at it before every transmission. If BUSY is lit all the time and you hear noise, your SQL is on OPEN and you need to raise it to the threshold.
Świeci, gdy radio ma ważną, aktualną poz: Lit when the radio has a valid, current position - from the built-in receiver or from the plotter via NMEA. Off or dimmed means the radio does not know where you are.
Alarm DISTRESS niesie twoją pozycję. Z p: A DISTRESS alert carries your position. With a position the rescuers have a point on the chart and head straight for you; without one they have only the MMSI and must locate you by radio direction-finding, so the operation becomes an order of magnitude slower and wider. That is exactly the difference the examiner asks about.
Sprawdzasz przy każdym rozruchu radia -: Check it every time the radio starts up - it is part of the pre-departure check. If the GPS has no fix, enter the position and time manually in the menu BEFORE you need them, not at the moment of an alert.
Pokazuje, jak radio słucha: DW to Dual W: Shows how the radio is listening: DW is Dual Watch (working channel plus 16), SCAN is scanning the favourites, and an empty field means an ordinary watch on a single channel.
Z tego jednego pola widzisz, czy nadal m: This one field tells you whether you still have a watch on 16. After switching to a working channel it is easy to forget, and the watch on 16 is the operator's duty, not an option.
Rzut oka po każdej zmianie kanału i prze: Glance at it after every channel change and before a longer exchange. Remember: SCAN turns DW off and vice versa - you cannot have both modes at once.
Pokazuje moc, z którą radio nada po wciś: Shows the power the radio will transmit with when you press PTT: 25 W (HI) or 1 W (LO). You switch it with the HI/LO softkey, and on low-power channels (15, 17, 75, 76) the radio shows 1 W whatever the setting.
To pole jest szybszym sprawdzeniem niż p: This field is a quicker check than remembering what you last set. 25 W over a short distance does not improve readability, but it ties up the channel for everyone in range - and VHF range is set by the radio horizon: a dozen or so miles between yachts, 20-30 miles to a coast station.
Rzucasz na nie okiem przed każdym nadani: Glance at it before every transmission, just as you do at the channel number. The wrong power is one of the most common mistakes noticed in the exam.
Wskaźnik zasilania: napięcie z instalacj: Power supply indicator: the voltage from the boat's electrics. A fixed VHF has no battery of its own - it lives off the boat's 12 V.
Radio bez prądu to brak nasłuchu i brak: A radio without power means no watch and no way to send an alert. Transmitting at 25 W is one of the biggest power draws on board, so with a weak battery the voltage drops exactly at the moment you transmit.
Kontrolujesz przed wyjściem: zasilanie,: Check it before leaving: supply, fuse, terminals. Under way, look here if the radio resets when you press PTT - that is a classic sign of a weak supply, not a fault in the radio.
Dolny wiersz LCD: TX gdy nadajesz (trzym: The bottom line of the LCD: TX when you are transmitting (holding PTT), RX when you are listening. The bar next to it shows the received signal strength when receiving and the output power when transmitting.
To jedyne potwierdzenie, że radio faktyc: It is the only confirmation that the radio has really gone on air and not just beeped. No reading while transmitting means a problem with the antenna, the microphone or the power supply - better to find out alongside the quay than in a gale.
Zerkasz na niego, gdy trzymasz PTT, i po: Glance at it while you hold PTT and during a radio test (a DSC test call or a call on 16 to a coast station). TX showing also means: right now you cannot hear anyone.
Ręczny mikrofon na spiralnym kablu, z kl: A handheld microphone on a coiled cable, with the PTT key on its side. It is your only voice input - the radio transmits exactly what it picks up, wind and engine included.
O odebraniu wiadomości decyduje zrozumia: Whether a message gets through depends on clarity, not loudness. Too close to your mouth - distortion and hiss; too far away - your voice is lost in the background, and with poor diction the rescuer wastes time asking again instead of acting.
Mów z około 5 cm, lekko z boku, spokojni: Speak from about 5 cm, slightly to the side, calmly and clearly - do not shout. After the exchange put the microphone back in its holder: left dangling, it catches on everything and can jam the PTT, which ties up the channel for the whole area.
